<b>Silver Bells</b> is a [[Gather Wishes|Gather Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, started from the wishwall in [[Bellhart]] once it becomes available.

== Wish ==
[[File:Silver Bell.png|link=Silver Bell|left|thumb|100x100px]]
{{For|more information about the spawn mechanic|Silver Bell}}

Eight [[Silver Bell]]s must be collected inside the bellvein tunnels above and below the town. Speckled throughout the tunnels are invisible spawn locations, with each having a 25% chance of dropping a Silver Bell. Equipping the [[Magnetite Dice]] increases this spawn chance to 30%.

The best way to complete the wish is to move around the area in loops, picking up any Silver Bells in sight. The tunnels beneath the Bellhart [[Bellway]] are an ideal gathering spot.

}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Rosary Necklace.png|link=Rosary Necklace|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After collecting eight Silver Bells and turning them in to Bellhart's wishwall, Hornet is rewarded with a [[Rosary Necklace]], which can be broken into {{R|120}}.
